audience: A 26-year-old with frizz-prone hair who styles it every morning and watches it puff up by lunch.
insight: You don't have bad hair days; you have humid days, and humidity wins every one of them.
device: a live match broadcast: a scoreboard of Humidity vs Your Hair, humidity 3 – 0 up, then before/after replays bring your hair back to win 3 – 4
device_why: frizz is a daily fight with the weather; the score turns the 72-hour frizz claim into a result you can watch flip

claims.text: 125% more shine* (*compared to bleached hair without Nº.7)
unretouched; results with Nº.4, Nº.5 and Nº.7
claims.source: the before/after film's own caption on the product page

music.title: Abracadabra
music.why: a transformation song — 'abracadabra' is the before/after; its biggest lift (16.5 s of the 30 s preview) lands on 'your hair wins'

look.why: a night-match broadcast: near-black ground, white type, the oil's amber as the one accent

beats.shows: three frizzy BEFOREs from the brand's replays, one per beat; humidity scores on each: 3 – 0
beats.serves: names the daily fight and who's losing it

beats.shows: she taps Nº.7 drops into her palm and works them through her hair, then the bottle lands as the hero
beats.serves: brings in the product as the move that changes the game

beats.shows: three unretouched before/after replays (dark curls, copper straight, brunette waves); after each point the after takes the whole screen; your hair pulls back 1, 2, 3
beats.serves: proves it with the brand's own before/after and claims

beats.shows: on the song's lift the winner, 3 – 4: glossy hair flips from two women who used Nº.7; FULL TIME
beats.serves: lands the SMP as a feeling: you beat the weather

beats.shows: the Nº.7 bottle hero on black, the OLAPLEX wordmark
beats.serves: what to buy, what it costs, where
